content.about: Bulgaria lies in southeastern Europe, with a Black Sea coast in the east and mountains across its middle and south. Its Rose Valley grows roses for a large share of the world's rose oil. It has ancient Thracian tombs and colourful monasteries like Rila. Bulgarian yoghurt is famous for its special bacteria.

standout.text: Bulgaria is home to the Cyrillic script's early development, at the Preslav and Ohrid schools.

didYouKnow: Lactobacillus bulgaricus, a yoghurt bacterium, is named after Bulgaria.
Bulgaria produces a large share of the world's rose oil.
The Varna gold treasure is among the oldest worked gold in the world.
